posts.cooked: I'd love to know how you made that box!

posts.name: SSJ3Godzilla
posts.cooked:
Silverleaf:

I'd love to know how you made that box!

I took an X acto knife to the inside of the bottom half of the rook city box to separate the sides and the bottom. I then tapped the sides on top of the bottom half of the wrath of the cosmos box and reinforced it with some thin card board (I specifically used the insert from Descent 2nd Ed.). Since I still had the very bottom of the box that fit nicely into the lid, I put all of the paperwork/manuals into the lid, covered them with the bottom, and put that whole piece on the bottom of the expanded wrath of the cosmos box. I just wanted another box with official art, so I made my own

Just FYI, a bit of math: there are 2,095 cards in the game (if my memory serves me correctly). This includes promos and all setup cards. Each premium pack comes with 50 sleeves. 2095/50=41.9. That means you'd have to buy 42 packs to sleeve all CURRENT cards in the game. 42 packs go for about $90 on Mayday Games' website, shipping included, at about $2.25 per pack. However, their customer service rep is super awesome and MIGHT give you a bulk discount if you ask nicely.

So...it's steep. Real steep. I ordered 20 packs for about $32 or so using some kind of discount. I'll have a lot of penny sleeves I'd be willing to sell off for cheap for whoever is interested. They're all in good shape. I'm just upgrading to the premiums.

I just picked up an aluminum case from Harbor Freight that fits all the sets with some room to spare.
